tools.name: find_routes
tools.description: Search Route Stories: about 2,000 real walking, running and cycling routes, dog walks and city tours (UK, United States, Italy, France, Spain), each a GPS audio tour with narrated stories and music. Search by place (town, county, state, country, area, route name or theme word) or by a lat/lng point,

tools.name: get_route
tools.description: One Route Stories route in full: description, highlights (the places its stories are about), distance, climb, time per activity, start point, parking, public transport, access, surface, dogs, nearby routes, and the url where the person hears and buys it.
